title: Parameterized mapping spaces for straightening
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functor categories, cores and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], Cartesian and cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], classification of [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening] and its Cartesian dual, and the infinity category of small categories of [lem-coef-cat-infinity-colimits-cartesian-closure]. Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ and a containing universe for its categories. Let $B,C$ be $\mathcal V$-small quasicategories, $H,G:B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal V}$ coherent functors, and $E_H,E_G\to B$ Cartesian fibrations classified by them. Write $\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{cart}}_B(E_H,E_G)$ for the full subcategory of the coherent functor category over $B$ on functors preserving Cartesian edges; write $\operatorname{Map}^{\mathrm{cart}}_B$ for its core. Give $C\times E_H\to B$ the projection to $B$. There are natural equivalences of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal V}}\bigl(C,\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{cart}}_B(E_H,E_G)\bigr)\simeq\operatorname{Map}^{\mathrm{cart}}_B(C\times E_H,E_G)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal V})}\bigl((\Delta C)\times H,G\bigr).$$
Here $(\Delta C)\times H$ has value $C\times H(b)$. For coherent covariant diagrams $H,G:B\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal V}$ and their cocartesian fibrations the same equivalences hold with $\mathrm{cocart}$ in place of $\mathrm{cart}$ and $B$ in place of $B^{\mathrm{op}}$ in the diagram category. These comparisons are compatible with composition, change of base, all transformations and higher simplices in the classified diagrams and the parameter $C$, and with enlarging the universe. The resulting Cartesian or cocartesian functor categories are $\mathcal V$-small quasicategories.
